title: Search query passed to Tantivy without sanitization
description: search.rs:73-74. The search function passes the user's query string directly to Tantivy's QueryParser::parse_query. Tantivy's query syntax supports field queries (content:word), boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), phrase queries, regex, and range queries. A user could craft queries like 'account_id:12345' to enumerate all posts by a specific account, or use expensive regex/wildcard queries to cause high CPU usage. The fallback on line 74 catches parse failures but not expensive valid queries. This is authenticated-only (requires auth token) which limits the attack surface.
